storage: Keep in an airtight box at room temperature in a dry place; for longer storage keep in the fridge. Soaked pulp or juice keeps about 3 to 4 days in the fridge.
looksLike: A sticky dark-brown pressed block or loose clump of fruit pulp with some fibre; the seedless (deseeded) type has had the hard shiny seeds removed.
howToPick: Dark brown, moist and soft with little fibre; check the pack says seedless. Avoid dry, hard or mouldy lumps and any with many seeds or grit.
shelfLife: Several months to a year in an airtight container (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 3 g per serving (a small marble-sized piece, about ½ tsp packed)
